scene-21.notes: This later exploration follows the first meeting. Projected plans and autonomous machinery come from the source. The group returns home exhilarated.

scene-25.notes: Connected source paragraphs remain intact and ordered. No invented casualty list, accident mechanism, farewell, ascension clarification or supernatural return. Glossary waits for the actual terms.

scene-32.notes: Retrospective wording allows passing years without asserting a fixed sprite age at every anniversary. No new adventures with Joren. The hopeful afterword is a separate editorial invitation, not a new in-universe event.
